Audit log
capabilities.notObservableReason: The add-on writes Connection, Audit, and Message logs to the single sourcetype cisco:etd and publishes no field that tells them apart. Message logs are covered by restricting the input to Message Logs.

capabilities.name: Per-flow permit and deny decisions
capabilities.notObservableReason: Cisco documents syslog export of permit and deny records and publishes no Splunk sourcetype or field list.

capabilities.name: IPFIX flow telemetry
capabilities.notObservableReason: Cisco documents IPFIX export from enforcement points and publishes no Splunk sourcetype or field list.

capabilities.name: Timescape management history
capabilities.notObservableReason: Cisco documents Timescape event history as reviewed in the Timescape UI and not exported; CSV export covers only the current page.

capabilities.name: Configuration change commits
capabilities.notObservableReason: Commit summaries are included in the same Splunk webhook notification as assertion changes, and Cisco publishes no JSON field that separates them.

capabilities.name: Fabric, node, and device inventory
capabilities.notObservableReason: The fabrics, nodes, and devices API is not collected by a Splunk add-on, and Cisco publishes no sourcetype or field extraction for it.

capabilities.name: Hardware alarm relay state
capabilities.notObservableReason: Relay contact state is shown by 'show facility-alarm status' and SNMP; only alarms configured with 'alarm facility <type> syslog' reach syslog, and those are covered by the HSR and PTP capabilities.
